label: PF Backlog 198
title: Backend: capability-pack registry + config + discovery->enablement (the pluggable switch)
body:
## Problem / why There is no way to turn media capabilities ON per project; everything is implicit. ## Goal A capability registry (mirrors core/knowledge_registry.py) + config/capability-packs.json: modality -> {tools, generator providers, agents, validators}. Discovery (0a) writes required_capabilities; the orchestrator ENABLES the matching pack. Nothing extra for a non-media project. ## In scope - capability pack schema + default packs (image, video, audio, 3d, none). - discovery emits required_capabilities; design/architect selects the pack into the tech stack. - Enable/disable agents+tools+models per pack. ## Acceptance criteria - Given a plain app idea, no media pack is enabled. - Given a reels/movie idea, the media pack is enabled and its agents/tools are active. ## Verification / test plan - Two ideas (app vs media) -> different enabled capabilities. ## Added — from docs/multimodal_selection_dynamic.md - Persist a project CAPABILITY PROFILE: `required_capabilities` (modalities + domain) written at discovery (0a), or at ideation (0) when media arrives at the start. Store: `products/

/capabilities.json` (single writer; register in store-registry.json). - Surface the profile to design/architect so pack selection uses it.

dashboard_impact.reason: Has a dashboard surface (see paired item).
